title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 JUL)
summary: A compilation of application improvement ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central submitted by the community, covering areas like Copilot and agents, financial management, development, inventory, manufacturing, sales, and administration. The post serves as a feature request collection spanning multiple system modules.
key_points: Community-sourced feature requests organized by Business Central functional areas
Suggestions span from agent and Copilot enhancements to performance improvements and workflow optimizations
Requests cover financial reconciliation, payment processing, inventory management, and reporting capabilities
Development and platform improvements include API enhancements, page scripting, and performance toolkit features
Localization requests address regional requirements like Thai calendar support and Mexican CFDI concepts

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central?
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a collection of community-suggested enhancements seeking validation and implementation consideration
